get_activation_relu: get a ReLU activation layer by calling get_activation with Activation.RELU
get_activation_leakyrelu: get a LeakyReLU activation layer by calling get_activation with Activation.LEAKYRELU
get_activation_tanh: get a Tanh activation layer by calling get_activation with Activation.TANH
get_activation_gelu: get a GELU activation layer by calling get_activation with Activation.GELU
get_activation_glu: get a GLU activation layer by calling get_activation with Activation.GLU and a dim argument
